name: simple-react-boilerplate
goal: Generate the same generic React project in another repository without extra demo folders or sample feature modules.

stack.routing: React Router with Next-style file-system pages
stack.theme: React Context with shared theme style config
stack.responsive: Mobile-first layouts for phone, tablet, and desktop

rules: Do not add example pages, mock data folders, or feature-specific modules by default.
Place reusable shell UI in src/components.
Place theme or other shared state in src/context.
Place low-level HTTP helpers in src/services/http.js.
Add new folders/ alter existing folder when the project has a real need for them.

routing.pattern: Each supported .jsx file inside src/pages becomes part of the route tree.

specialFiles.layout.jsx: Wraps descendant routes without changing the URL.
specialFiles.(group): Route group folder ignored in the URL.

features: layout.jsx creates shared route wrappers for a folder tree.
Folders wrapped in parentheses are ignored in the final URL.
Files or folders prefixed with an underscore are ignored by the router.

sampleRoute.purpose: Show how a simple route can consume theme-managed styles.

themeStyles.usage: Resolved theme styles are exposed from ThemeContext and consumed by pages and layout.

behavior: Stores the selected theme in localStorage.
Resolves system theme to light or dark mode.
Exposes themeStyles so UI surfaces can reuse centralized theme classes.

content.purpose: Shared dummy data and reusable boilerplate copy.

pages.purpose: File-system routes with nested layouts and dynamic segments.

theme.purpose: Centralized theme-managed style definitions for the app shell and pages.

services.purpose: Shared HTTP helpers and low-level integrations.
